opener_label.description: Label used to initiate a conversation or chat session.

chat_talk_button.description: Button label to activate voice or speech input in the chat.

chat_talk_input_placeholder.description: Placeholder text in the chat input box prompting the user to type their message.

chat_card_button_translate.description: Button label for translating the content of a chat message to another language.

chat_card_button_paraphrase.description: Button label for rephrasing the content of a chat message to convey the same meaning in different words.

chat_card_button_gm_check.description: Button label to initiate a grammar check on the content of a chat message.

chat_toggle_autoplay.description: Toggle switch label for automatically playing voice messages or media in the chat.

chat_talk_clear_button.description: Button label to clear the content of the chat input box.

chat_card_paraphrase_loading.description: Loading message for the paraphrase feature.

chat_card_gmcheck_loading.description: Loading message for the grammar check feature.

card_vocab_sentence_label.description: Label for the sentence in a vocabulary card.

card_vocab_example_label.description: Label for the example sentence in a vocabulary card.

card_vocab_button_save.description: Save button label for saving a vocabulary card.

card_vocab_button_discard.description: Discard button label for discarding a vocabulary card.
